sentences.text:
The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents
not to compel the petitioners to execute sale-deed in favour of the State-respondents without
following the procedure prescribed under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land
Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and retrain them from taking possession of
their land without following the due process of law and for a further direction to decide their
representations dated 28.10.2024 and 29.10.2024 and pay compensation to the petitioners along
with interest at the present market value.

sentences.text: Case of the petitioners is that they are owners of a piece of land measuring 76.11 square meter of Araji No. 163, village Shaha @ Peepalgaon, Tehsil Sadar, District Prayagraj.
The respondents require the said land for expansion of the existing Airport at Prayagraj.
They are being compelled by the State-respondents to execute sale-deed of their land in favour of the State without offering them proper compensation/sale consideration.

3. The State-respondents have placed on record the written instructions, according to which, it is not disputed that the aforesaid land of the petitioners is required by the respondents for expansion of the Airport.

However, the case taken up by the respondents in the written instructions is that a notification under Section 11 of Act No. 30 of 2013 was issued on 26.11.2024 followed by notification under Section 19 dated 28.12.2024.
The affected persons have been issued notice to file their objections on or before 28.01.2025 and after that, award would be made.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners very fairly states that petitioners would participate in the proceedings relating to determination of compensation.

5. Since the basis of filing the instant petition that the petitioners are being compelled to execute sale-deed no more exists as respondents have already initiated proceedings for compulsory acquisition and therefore, we dispose of the instant petition with liberty to the petitioners to participate in the proceedings for determination of compensation as per the provisions of Act No. 30 of 2013.

Order Date :- 6.1.2025 Mukesh Kr.
(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
